svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Retired-id redirection across the toolchain
svg.desc: The six deleted rules leave a trail of stale ids in config files, suppression markers, fixture declarations and CLI calls. RETIRED_RULE_IDS is the one table every consumer reads to turn those into a message naming unplaceable-reference.
